text.en: Dog owners praise head trainer Chris for his professional expertise, straightforward communication, and ability to instruct pet owners alongside their dogs. While one reviewer expressed disappointment over boarding fees and photo policies, most clients consider him exceptional.

Clients report dramatic behavioural improvements after the 10-day board-and-train programme, noting that dogs stop pulling and jumping within minutes. Pet parents praise how quickly rambunctious rescue dogs become calm, responsive, and easy to manage during daily walks.

Reviewers emphasize the trainer's skilled approach with strong, energetic, and stubborn breeds, including Rottweilers, Goldendoodles, and rescue pit mixes. Owners appreciate that training instills lasting discipline while preserving each dog's affectionate personality.

q.en: What is the duration of the signature board-and-train programme?

a.en: The centre offers an intensive 10-day board-and-train programme followed by a one-on-one instructional lesson for owners.

q.en: Does the training address leash pulling and jumping?

a.en: Yes, clients report rapid progress in curbing severe leash pulling, jumping on guests, and stubborn walking habits.

q.en: Are owners instructed on how to continue training at home?

a.en: Yes, Chris conducts hands-on handover sessions to ensure pet parents know how to enforce commands and maintain progress.

q.en: Does Stronghaus work with rescue dogs and strong breeds?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently bring rescue dogs, Rottweilers, and large energetic mixes for behavioural rehabilitation.
